data.narrative: Authored a complete 3 AM operations manual (docs/service-overview.md) and three copy-pasteable linear-checklist incident runbooks (high-error-rate, high-latency, service-down) wired directly to Prometheus alerts. Rigorously live-tested the HighErrorRate runbook verbatim against a simulated 500/503 outage, catching and eliminating 3 real defects (a nonexistent Docker tag assumption, shell regex fragility, and deploy placeholder), and hardened the runbook with a Step 0 live topology drift check.

dimension_scores.observation: Integrated exact Docker operational commands (docker inspect OOMKilled/ExitCode, docker restart, memory-capped rollback containers, and immutable git-SHA tags) directly into runbooks.
dimension_scores.evidence: Documented exact container health, OOM inspection, and SHA-based rollback procedures across docs/service-overview.md and docs/runbooks/service-down.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Caught a real CI/CD-to-runbook contract mismatch during live testing (nonexistent :previous-stable tag vs CI's immutable git-SHA tagging) and added automated runbook smoke verification.
dimension_scores.evidence: Replaced :previous-stable with PREV_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD~1) and verified runbook commands via scripts/verify-module-07-runbook-test.ts.

dimension_scores.observation: Linked every Prometheus alert in infra/alerts.yml one-to-one with a dedicated runbook citing exact PromQL triggers, /metrics scrape filters, and structured JSON failure_mode fields.
dimension_scores.evidence: Connected HighErrorRate, HighLatency, and ServiceDown alerts directly to docs/runbooks/high-error-rate.md, high-latency.md, and service-down.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Anticipated operational documentation rot (config drift, renamed containers, missing sidecars, port shifts) and mitigated it structurally with a Step 0 live topology check and quarterly GameDay testing policy.
dimension_scores.evidence: Added Step 0 `docker ps --format` drift check and documented all 3 drift scenarios in progress/module_07_break_diagnosis.json.

dimension_scores.observation: Documented Module 06 graceful degradation behaviors (HTTP 202 queued_fallback, circuit_breaker_state=2, Redis-to-DB fallback) inside the operations manual and latency runbook so operators do not misinterpret healthy degradation as a crash.
dimension_scores.evidence: Included POST /notifications/send 202 fallback verification step inside docs/runbooks/high-latency.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Delivered exceptional 3 AM operational documentation with zero placeholders, copy-pasteable commands, dual positive/negative expected outputs, 2-minute post-fix soak checks, and timed escalation ladders.
dimension_scores.evidence: Authored docs/service-overview.md and 3 complete incident runbooks under docs/runbooks/, empirically verified via live test harness.
